Pickleball Shot Data for a Professional Women's Player.

Source: R/data.R
pickleball.Rd

Data on pickleball shots made by a professional women's player for their "third shot in a rally" ball. Coordinates are where this player is making the shot from (not where her ball is landing on the other side of the net).

Usage

pickleball

Format

A tibble object with 110 rows and 6 columns:

  • loc_x: the x-coordinate of where the player is standing when the shot is made.

  • loc_y: the y-coordinate of where the player is standing when the shot is made.

  • shot_type: a factor with two levels: tsDrp for third-shot-drop and tsDrv for third-shot-drive.

  • shot_type_num: an indicator variable that is equal to a 0 if the third shot is a drop shot and a 1 if the third shot is a drive.

  • shot_id: an identification number for the shot (not used here).

  • rally_id: an identification number for the rally (not used here).

Source

Data were modified from Kaggle at https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/cakesofspan/pklmarts-competitive-pickleball-extracts/data?select=shot.csv. The Kaggle data was originally obtained from the pklmart Python package.

References

Gupta, S. S. (2023). pklmart: A Python package for competitive pickleball data analysis.
